91328.synopsis:
Abstinence, mature and gentle dad-type Alpha × rebellious and defiant Omega
Before marrying into the richest family in Jiangcheng, An Xun did his homework thoroughly. His future husband, Bo Xiangzhou, liked obedient people. However, An Xun had a foul temper, loved to swear, and often got into fights. He couldn’t be further from obedient.

When his husband wasn’t looking, An Xun would curse under his breath, full of resentment, and could fend off a group of Alphas with just a bottle of wine. But when his husband was around, he would appear weak, fragile, and pitiful, with acting skills that could rival a top-tier celebrity.
Day after day, An Xun lay by Bo Xiangzhou’s side, calling him “husband” in a delicate voice. But when he met Bo Xiangzhou’s knowing smile, a shiver ran down his spine.
Had he… been found out?
An Xun, wrapped in his fragile disguise, continued to dance around Bo Xiangzhou’s boundaries.
At a banquet, he showed up looking pitiful and was subjected to harsh words from others. After dealing with them in a place where his husband couldn’t see, he turned around only to bump into Bo Xiangzhou.
Despite the undeniable evidence, Bo Xiangzhou firmly believed that his little liar was the one who had been mistreated.
Bo Xiangzhou, selectively blind: “My baby is an obedient sweetheart. There’s no way he’d hit anyone. If it did happen, he must’ve been forced.”
Bystanders: “Mr. Bo, can the surveillance footage lie? Who has ever seen a ‘good baby’ who curses like a sailor and hits as hard as a boxer?”
An Xun, clutching his husband’s sleeve: Feeling guilty…

92352.synopsis:
“Is it that you don’t even want to deal with a bottom-feeder gangster like me?” 
“…Yes. I don’t like people like you, like Kwon Siheon.” 
“Let’s not see each other again. I don’t know what I’ll do if we meet next time.”
Yoo Yisoo, the high and noble princess of Hyoshin Group. Kwon Siheon, the ‘Butcher’ of the Shinuehoe, who volunteered to protect her. It seemed like their connection was coming to an end, but…
“This is Yoo Yisoo. I believe you’ll remember.” 
“It’s been a while.” 
“Help me. Please. I’ll do anything, anything if it means I can protect my siblings and myself.”

In an instant, the Hyoshin Group collapses, and even their lives are at risk. Yoo Yisoo seeks out Kwon Siheon as the one person who can protect them.
“Don’t get any funny ideas. Don’t think of running away or betraying me.” 
“That won’t… That won’t happen.” 
“Then you’d better behave like a good, obedient dog, right?” 
“…….” 
“From head to toe, your body is completely under my control. Got it?”
Yoo Yisoo takes Kwon Siheon’s hand. As she spends perilous days by his side, devoid of mercy, the moment arrives when she betrays him and breaks their contract…
What will be the outcome of the blind contract made with this cruel yet beautiful man?

93376.synopsis:
Facing execution by burning, the Great Witch chose to betray. In doing so, she saved her life – at least until she could see her homeland reduced to ashes. Only then would she gladly embrace death.
The Inquisitor leading the witch hunt saw the Great Witch, and it was then that he began to doubt. He resolved to save her, even if it meant turning the sacred world to ash.
“I will destroy everything.”
Vienny’s eyes moved to her bound wrist, feeling the slight trembling in the big man’s fingers.
“I will burn everything you desire…”
The slight trembling in his fingers quickly disappeared as his grip tightened.
“Just give yourself to me.”
Vienny swallowed hard several times before finally answering with difficulty.
“You said that even God would reject this body.”
“God may indeed reject it,” he replied, his voice calm and steady.
“Which is why I will claim you and keep you by my side for the rest of my life.”
Vienny slowly lifted her head. In Maclath’s face, frighteningly cold, she saw the desperation that was all too familiar to her.
“Even if it means holding you and falling into hell together.”

95424.synopsis:
Su Chen transmigrated into a Xuanhuan novel, fortunate enough to become the only son of the Su Family, the most prominent clan in Donghua Region. Unfortunately, he was the villain.
In this world of Xuanhuan, where Sons of Destiny walked everywhere and Chosen by Heaven were as common as dogs, his Su Family, despite being the largest power in the Eastern Region, could lose everything with a single misstep!

How could he endure this?
So what if it was the Heavenly Dao!
He would defy the heavens!
***
In the world of Tianxuan Continent, where power reigns supreme and destiny is predetermined, Su Chen awakens as the villain of a cultivation novel. Knowing his fate is to be a mere stepping stone for the protagonist’s rise, he vows to shatter the narrative. 
Armed with the knowledge of the original plot and the resources of his powerful family, Su Chen embarks on a ruthless journey to rewrite his destiny. 
He sets his sights on Ye Fan’s cultivation opportunities, seduces his destined companions, and manipulates the intricate web of family politics to his advantage.

But as his power grows and his enemies multiply, he must navigate treacherous alliances and face the consequences of his actions. Can a villain truly usurp the protagonist’s role, or will fate ultimately have its way?
associated_names: 反派：开局强娶主角师尊，我无敌

95680.synopsis:
Once upon a time,
In a bizarre village cut off from the outside world called Mindie, lived Cinq, who was known as ‘Red Riding Hood’.
She belonged to Vinya, the brothel keeper, and the village’s highest authority, the priest known as ‘White Goat’, cherished her deeply.
The villagers whispered that the first person to remove her red hood would be the ‘White Goat’.
However, on the eve of the new year, a fugitive clad in a wolf-shaped helm and covered in wounds appeared, striking down Vinya and claiming the brothel keeper’s bed as his own.
Thanks to the ‘Wolf’, Cinq gained her freedom, and she decided to tend to the injured wolf for a little while…

97984.synopsis:
In the final years of the dynasty, demons ran rampant, the world was in turmoil, and human life was as worthless as grass. Even powerful martial artists faced constant threats to their lives.

[Dragon Tendon and Tiger Bone Pill （Martial Arts Pill） → Cultivating Origin Pill （Immortal Path Pill） → Foundation Establishment Pill （Immortal Path Pill）…] 
[Grass and Wood Breathing Technique （Martial Arts Cultivation Technique） → Eternal Spring Technique （Immortal Path Cultivation Technique）…] 
And so…
He rose from a mountain village hunter, step by step, to become a renowned expert in these chaotic times.
One day, Chu Liang chanced upon an immortal who had descended into the deep mountains. He learned that this world was merely a small world used by immortals to harvest “Human Path Pills.”
Chu Liang wished to enter the Immortal Realm, but was told that his “Spiritual Root” was inferior, and he was not qualified.
He had no choice but to give up and continue cultivating in the mortal world.
…
Many years later, countless immortals descended, bringing calamities, disrupting the human world, and harvesting the Grand Human Path Pill.
At the critical moment, Chu Liang took action.
Immortals fell, like rain.
Looking at the radiant Chu Liang, the surviving immortals were utterly shocked.
“You… are you that mortal with the inferior Spiritual Root from back then?”
✿✿✿
In a world where the clash of steel and the roar of demons echo through the mountains, Chu Liang, a reincarnated soul, finds himself armed with an extraordinary gift – the Evolutionary Appraisal Mirror. 
Betrayed by those he once considered family and facing a world steeped in danger, Chu Liang must harness the mirror’s power to forge his own destiny. 
From a simple hunter to a rising martial artist, his journey is fraught with peril, forcing him to confront greedy relatives, ruthless gangs, and the encroaching darkness of a demonic threat. With each evolution, 
Chu Liang grows stronger, his resolve hardening as he strives to carve a path towards survival and mastery in the turbulent world of the Great Liang Dynasty.

98240.synopsis:

Neon lights flash. A friend stares at a man in a booth: “Holy crap, that guy is so handsome! He’s a god!”

Still in the same white shirt, but without his glasses, his prim and proper arranged marriage partner is being given a lap dance.
Xi Shi, feeling utterly betrayed, rips the dancer off Zhong Yuxiao: “Get lost.”
The people in the booth tease: “Oh, which little lover is this who came looking for you? Spicy.”

If he seized him by force, he is a robber; if he is being patient and indifferent, he will be meat in someone else’s chopsticks.

It’s a long-standing battle.

104896.synopsis:
Wei Zhuang had been a noble daughter-in-law for many years, shouldering the burdens and complaints, and upholding the virtues of a dignified lady. Suddenly, she felt tired of it. In the eyes of outsiders, she seemed to have married well and should be grateful.
Her husband, Xie Jingyan, was a talented and virtuous man who held a high position in the government. He was also a devoted husband who didn’t take concubines and treated Wei Zhuang generously. But how could they know that the couple had been living in separate rooms for many years, and their relationship had long been exhausted? They were just going through the motions.
One day, Wei Zhuang woke up to find herself back in her maiden state, before she got married. She was still young and full of vitality, without the burdens of her married life. She hadn’t been used by the Xie family as a shield for the princess, and she didn’t have to worry about giving birth to a son who would be taken away by her mother-in-law. She also didn’t have to tolerate her husband’s mistress.
Wei Zhuang smiled to herself, feeling a sense of freedom. She stroked her slender waist and touched her soft and delicate cheeks. Looking at the luxurious flowers in the boat cabin, she thought to herself, “This life, I’ll be a rare and beautiful black peony. Let’s start with breaking off the engagement.”
—
Xie Jingyan came from a noble family, and was known for his integrity and virtue. But for some reason, he kept dreaming of a beautiful woman with a mole on her neck. She was lying beside him, soft and fragrant. This made him feel disturbed, and when he leaned in to take a closer look, he suddenly woke up. Until one day, he realized that his fiancée, who was coming to the capital from Yunzhou, was the woman in his dreams.
Xie Jingyan felt relieved and happy to have found his dream woman. He thought to himself, “After we get married, I’ll definitely treat her well.”
But who would have thought that the woman would say, “I’m sorry, I want to break off the engagement.”
Xie Jingyan asked, “What’s wrong?”
Note: This is a story about a couple who gets married first and then falls in love. 
The content tags include: a love that is predestined by fate, a contract marriage that turns into love, and a husband who chases after his wife to make amends for past misunderstandings.
One-sentence summary: A contractual marriage that blossoms into love.
Theme: The story emphasizes the importance of self-reliance, self-improvement, and creating a beautiful life.

106432.synopsis:
In the novel “Jiao Jiao,” the Omega female lead, Song Jiao, is forced to marry the s*umbag Alpha, Xu Jinzhao. She is ab*sed by the psychologically twisted Alpha but cannot resist due to her Omega instincts.

She will protect Song Jiao at all costs, even if it means digging out her own s*upid Xu Jinzhao glands, she will not let her instincts harm her.

Jiang Tang found himself in the interstellar era after a plane crash. He opened his eyes to discover that he had become the “real young master” who had just been found by the Jiang family from a garbage planet.

Waking up one day, Lin Shu transmigrates to the interstellar era, becoming the youngest son of the prestigious Lin family of the Imperial Star… only to learn the very next day that the family has found their long-lost true heir. “Humanity will ultimately reclaim light and freedom, return to the surface, and embrace a rose-like love.”
More than fifty years have passed since the Great Cataclysm, and the surface has long been completely overrun by an unknown ecosystem born from mutated flora.
Chai Yuening rescues an exceedingly beautiful young girl from the surface.
The girl has lost her memory, knowing nothing of her past. Like an injured kitten, she warily curls up in a corner, resisting any approaching stranger. Only when her gaze falls upon Chai Yuening does a glimmer of light appear in her eyes.

Adhering to the principle that one is responsible for whom one saves, Chai Yuening takes her home.
Gradually, she discovers a problem.
This beautiful, silent girl—who seems so well-behaved and fragile, and clings to her every day—appears to be a mutated “plant.”

When they saw me getting beat up, they went nuts, laughing like maniacs, going, “Ahahaha!”

“Hey, why don’t you reflect on yourself a bit more?”

Just then, a big hand lands on the purple-haired girl’s head.

122560.synopsis:
After becoming a freshman majoring in Cryptography, Li Landao was informed of an arranged marriage with the Dan family, the top financial conglomerate in the Imperial Capital.
At first, he thought it was media gossip.
However, his grandfather actually said it was true, and it was a childhood engagement.
Grandpa is committed to cultivating ordinary people who stay away from the life of financial conglomerates. If he were to personally choose a suitable marriage partner for him, he should choose someone gentle and stable.

The peaceful college life was heading towards a dangerous, irreversible path.

Under the streetlight, his profile was expressionless, and he walked carelessly, but suddenly shifted his gaze, looking directly at Li Landao upstairs.
After their eyes met, Li Landao quickly scrambled back into bed.
…Damn it. This young master is going to escape the marriage!

[First Time] 
Dan Xiao: Boring. I’m not gay.

Dan Xiao: Go to the cryptography seminar by yourself.

Reason for failure: Academic exchange became too intimate.

Dan Xiao, with a cold face: You’ve breached the contract.
Dan Xiao: We agreed you wouldn’t cheat.
Reason for failure: An enemy used a honey trap.

Dan Xiao immediately put the agreement into the shredder: Not a chance.
One is the sharpest blade of the conglomerate family, and the other is the orphaned son of former genius cryptographers. Their titles sound grand, but they hold little real power.
Moreover, Dan Xiao is not Old Man Dan’s biological grandson; he’s just a nominal member of the Dan family.
But Li Landao never expected to receive a letter from the Duke’s family one day.
It stated a noble title awarded for his spouse.
Li Landao: ?

A friend, upon learning that they were in a family alliance, asked: So you have no interest in each other?
Dan Xiao: That was my original plan.
Li Landao: Then what are you rubbing against now?

123328.synopsis:
“I can’t believe it myself, but it’s true that you and Rona were switched.”
“That’s impossible. How could that happen?”
Ariel, the only daughter of the prestigious Marquis Jiles family, lived her life believing she was destined for nobility.
One day, she hears an earth-shattering revelation: the parents who raised her for over 20 years are not her biological parents. She had been switched at birth with the daughter of a maid.
Soon after, Ariel is forcibly expelled from her family, stripped of her title, and left to fend for herself.
“Count Leonard?”
“Don’t call me that. Please call me by my name. You used to call me Lucas, didn’t you?”
While trying to adjust to life as a commoner, Ariel wakes up in an unfamiliar place.
Standing before her is Lucas, her former fiancé, whom she believed had chosen her noble family over her.
Lucas, now Count Leonard, seems determined to reclaim Ariel, refusing to let her go. But what is he hiding behind his obsessive pursuit?
* * *
“Are you scared?”
Ariel nodded.
“I’ll apologize in advance. I’m sorry. Even if you’re scared, I can’t stop. I’ve waited so long for this moment… Today, I won’t be asking for your permission.”
“Why…”
“You once told me that I would always be welcome. Do you remember what I said in response?”
Ariel remembered it clearly:
‘If I get the chance, I will.’
“Now that the opportunity has come, I’m simply keeping that promise.”
Though he spoke calmly and composedly, raw desire dripped from Lucas’s voice. Ariel found herself slowly nodding. It felt like falling into a sweet yet dangerous trap.

128192.synopsis:
Chen Yao transmigrated into a xianxia world, becoming the young master of one of the continent’s strongest forces, Black Wind Mountain Stronghold. 
Born unable to cultivate? Luckily, upon transmigrating, he awakened the Villain System. 
He can plunder the destiny protagonist’s fortune value and use it for himself. 
The very first mission: marry the protagonist’s master. 
Excellent. Very good. 
On the Xuantian Continent, this young master’s rules are the only rules!

133568.synopsis:
Edwin and Leira had grown up as childhood friends, freely moving between each other’s homes since they were young.
Nothing much had ever changed between them—until the day they came of age after their adulthood ceremonies.
“Teach me how to pleasure myself.”
At Edwin’s request, Leira hesitated inwardly but, swayed by the way he gazed up at him like a docile puppy, reluctantly agreed.
Unaware of the dark intentions lurking beneath Edwin’s words.
From then on, Leira’s body was gradually broken in by Edwin’s relentless advances, his endless stamina leaving Leira screaming day after day.
Then, one day, worried by Edwin’s unusually listless demeanor, Leira went looking for him—only to discover a monstrous creature with demonic green eyes in his bathtub……

135616.synopsis:
The Imperial family of the Yong Dynasty, the Lans, were famously a family of madmen.
They possessed bloodlines of innate nobility, peerlessly beautiful features, unparalleled intellect, and personalities marked by coldness, cruelty, madness, and delusion.
This very nature destined them to slaughter one another for the throne, until victory or death.
Born exceptional, yet destined for a miserable end.
Lan Yihuan had been the victor in the previous succession war.
He ascended as an exalted sovereign. During his reign, the nation prospered and enjoyed peace, yet his kin perished one by one, leaving him utterly alone.
He ultimately died from exhaustion, only to be remembered posthumously as a harsh and ungrateful ruler.
‘Fine, fine. Serves me right. I never wanted this job anyway!‘
When he opened his eyes again, he found himself reborn as a six-year-old prince, bound to a system.
The system boasted loudly about helping him become Emperor.
Lan Yihuan: “…I’d rather just die and go back.”
He planned to outsource the tasks the system assigned him.
—
【A qualified Emperor must thoroughly study the Four Books and Five Classics.
Today’s task: Read ten volumes of the sages’ writings.
Task reward: A plate of cherries from the South Sea tribute!】
Lan Yihuan took the Crown Prince’s hand and placed rare, hard-to-find books before him.
“Study diligently! Once you finish, Father Emperor will look at you with newfound respect!”
“As for me… I’ve got cherries to eat.”
In this life, Lan Yihuan desired only to enjoy the perks of an Emperor without enduring its hardships.
To achieve this dream, he resolved to use the Imperial System to cultivate promising talents as tools to help him realize his dream.
*
Though bearing the title of Crown Prince of the Yong Dynasty, he was constantly suspected by the Emperor, and the father and son had always been at odds.
One night, he suffered a nightmare: he lost the throne and died in despair.
The root of all this misery? Six-year-old Lan Yihuan.
A strategist advised, “Your Majesty, the Seventh Prince possesses the majesty of a dragon and the grace of a phoenix. His piercing gaze betrays ambition. He must be eliminated!”
Taking action against a six-year-old child seemed pointless.
The Crown Prince cast a cold glance at the boy still lazily in bed in broad daylight, then walked away.
Little did he know then that this child would come to occupy such a significant place in his heart.
Unfazed by his coldness, the boy silently stood by during his anguish, fiercely defended him against the Emperor’s injustices, and would often lift his smiling face to declare:
“I like Brother Crown Prince the most.”
Those words redeemed countless nights of bitter resentment.
Eventually, he realized the depth of the boy’s place in his heart.
It surpassed even… that throne.
“I don’t want to be Emperor anymore,” he confessed to his beloved younger brother. “All I want is for you to be safe and happy.”
The Crown Prince failed to notice the shock and anguish in Lan Yihuan’s eyes.
Until the next day, when he saw the little brat fawning over that Third Brother who always opposed him——
“I like Third Brother the most!”
Crown Prince: “!!!!!”
*
The Crown Prince finally understood.
To win Lan Yihuan’s affection, he didn’t need to abandon the throne for him, he needed to——
Work for him!!!
Seriously, who wouldn’t love a stand-in worker who “does the job while you collect the pay”?
The ministers panicked.
Because they noticed the Crown Prince showed more enthusiasm at work than ever before!
—Does raising children also require internal competition?
Finally, the Crown Prince ascended the throne.
Lan Yihuan also reunited with his biological parents, restoring his true identity.
On the day of the coronation, the Emperor exceeded protocol by conferring the title of Regent Prince upon Lan Yihuan, bestowing upon him the title “Chen.”
Thus, throughout this dynasty, all knew that the Emperor lived a life of celibacy, his harem forever empty. His sole, lifelong love was Prince Chen.
Having ascended this throne, my sole wish is to surrender the world to win your favor.
PS: The protagonist is not of Imperial blood; the gong and the shou share no familial ties. No intimate actions occur before the truth of their origins is revealed.

143040.synopsis:
Veterinarian Xia Zhi Ning exhausted her health and wealth for the Xia family.
The day the real heiress returned, the sickly Xia Zhi Ning was kicked out of the house.
Too poor to afford treatment, Xia Zhi Ning recovered from a high fever—
only to discover she could suddenly understand what animals were saying!
A squirrel outside her window said she’d been targeted by a serial killer!
Panicked, Xia Zhi Ning suddenly remembered:
She had an estranged older brother who was a rookie cop…
and desperate to boost his stats.
And hey—
One wanted criminal = 500,000 yuan reward!
The Xia family stole her animal vaccine patent and threw her out like tr*sh,
thinking she’d just quietly die.
They never expected the tables would turn.
Suddenly, high-level elites they couldn’t even dream of befriending were lining up to beg Xia Zhi Ning to treat their animals.
Even her broke, low-ranking brother quickly rose through the ranks—
and became the youngest commander in police history!
The Xia family was filled with regret and begged her to return,
while the green tea real heiress nearly ground her teeth to dust in fury.
Xia Family: “Zhi Ning, come home—we’ll give you the family pet hospital to manage!”
Top Global Research Institute: “Excuse you, your pathetic hospital couldn’t even afford our lead professor’s trained dog.”
Xia Family: “Zhi Ning, getting dumped isn’t shameful—we’ve found you a new fiancé…”
A certain mysterious, powerful heir chasing his wife like his life depended on it:
“Scram. That breakup never counted!”
His rescue wolfdog only listens to her.
His gentleness is only for her.
The Xia family tried moral blackmail:
“We raised you for 22 years! You owe us everything you have!”
The Nation’s Daddy stepped in:
“Touch one hair on my daughter and you’ll see who’s boss.”

157376.synopsis:
Lee Yeonrok grew up an orphan, his life defined by hardship and a string of bad luck.
But he held onto one hope: his “Name.”
Five years after it manifested on his body, the call he had been waiting for finally came from the Matching Center. Filled with breathless anticipation, he went to meet his fated partner, dreaming of a sweet, romantic future.
Instead, he found three men waiting for him.
A Chaebol CEO. A Top Actor. A Cold-hearted Researcher.
Three Name Partners?
The situation was absurd enough on its own, but the reality was worse. From the moment they laid eyes on him, all three treated him with blatant, icy contempt.
“Aaaargh! You personality wrecks! You sons of b*tches!”
I waited five years for this? For a happy life with my soulmate?
Was I supposed to smile and be nice while they ignored me? Was I supposed to cater to people who openly hated me, just because they were disappointed that a “shabby thing” like me turned out to be their fate?

165568.synopsis:
In her previous life, Le Yao had finally managed to open a clinic for the blind and support herself— only to lose her life in a fire.
When she opened her eyes again, she had somehow transmigrated to the Tang Dynasty, and immediately heard a cold voice ordering that she be buried in a pit.
Le Yao: “…W-wait, spare me!!!”
She desperately stretched out her hand and grabbed onto the man’s robe.
Looking up in panic, she suddenly met a pair of eyes as clear and cold as mountain snow.
The original body was the daughter of a disgraced official, who, during exile, chose death by poison rather than suffer humiliation.
And the man before her was Yue Zhiyuan, a Commandant of the Ganzhou Protectorate.
Today, he had just been inexplicably transferred away from the front lines by his superior and reassigned to handle trivial duties like processing detained officials. Already irritated, he unexpectedly ran into this situation…
He lowered his gaze toward the woman on the ground—her hair disheveled, blood flowing from all seven orifices, her appearance terrifying—as their eyes met in silence.
A thought arose in his mind: …A corpse coming back to life?
Then he heard the “female ghost,” clutching him and accidentally touching his injured leg, blurt out:
“You’ve dislocated your ankle joint.”
Yue Zhiyuan: ?
What joint? What dislocation?
“D-do you want… a free bone-setting?”
Yue Zhiyuan: ??
Since when do female ghosts know how to set bones???
